name: PostProductionDeliverablesTracker
tagline: Every master, stem, subtitle and cue sheet – per programme, platform and territory – from QC to accepted.
description: A complete Power Platform app for distribution and post-production teams: a deliverables matrix per programme, platform and territory, technical specs per platform, internal QC gate, due dates with overdue and due-soon flags, platform acceptance and rejection, redeliveries with attempt tracking, a standard-package generator and a vendor / licensee portal for Power Pages.
features: Deliverables matrix with risk roll-up and drill-down
9 statuses with enforced transitions and reasons
Platform / category technical specs with prefill
QC gate, QC lanes and first-time pass rate
Acceptance, rejection and redelivery attempts with limit warning
Bulk status moves with partial validation and undo
